newsitem.title: THAILAND: Buba not looking for specific mark level - Gaddum.
newsitem.headline: Buba not looking for specific mark level - Gaddum.

text.p: Bundesbank vice-president Johann Wilhelm Gaddum said on Thursday that the German central bank was not looking for a specific level for the mark.
Traditionally Bundesbank policy was price-oriented and not exchange rate oriented, he told Reuters Financial Television. "I think therefore it is not accommodated to mention one figure."
Gaddum, who is in Bangkok to attend the 32nd Southeast Asian central bank governors' conference, was responding to a question on whether the Bundesbank favoured a specific dollar-mark level.

The dollar's recent strength has put most major currencies under pressure. Last weekend, the industrialised Group of Seven nations (G7) arrived at a consensus at a meeting in Berlin that the surging dollar had risen far enough.
Gaddum said he beleived that the G7 consensus was still intact.
